title: Payroll BE – Consultants channel: De Kroon input deadline

messages.author: p-nora
messages.text: Quick question: Brouwerij De Kroon says their payroll input deadline is now the 7th working day. The procedure says the 5th. Who's right?

messages.author: p-pieter
messages.text: Both :) For De Kroon only, we moved their deadline to the 7th working day while they migrate to mysdworx. The parallel runs make their input late. This applies until the end of December 2026, then it's back to the 5th.

messages.author: p-nora
messages.text: Is that written down somewhere? I couldn't find it in their client file.

messages.author: p-pieter
messages.text: Not yet. Sofie approved it verbally last week. I'll add it to the client file when I find the time.

messages.author: p-jens
messages.text: Does the same apply to Garage Verhaeghe? They're migrating too.

messages.author: p-pieter
messages.text: No, only De Kroon for now. Everyone else stays on the 5th working day.
